question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

She insisted on complete transparency (1)/ from all officials involved (2)/ before implementing immediately (3)/ the new policy (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in part **3**, where the word "**immediately**" is misplaced.
 
• The adverb "immediately" should logically modify the verb "implementing" and not "policy."
 
• The correct placement of "immediately" would be before "implementing" to ensure clarity and grammatical accuracy.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She insisted on complete transparency from all officials involved before immediately implementing the new policy."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "She insisted on complete transparency"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 2: "from all officials involved"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "****the new policy****"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
